title: Swap a switch
heading: Swap {{name}}
intro: A dead switch out, a spare in: pick the spare, give it the last config copy, patch every seat back to the same port, then mark it swapped.
keeps: The switch keeps its name and management IP, so the seat mapping, the cables and the monitoring carry on. Only the hardware changes.
step1Desc: Switches on the shelf (status: in inventory), the same model first.
noSpares: No switch of this kind is on the shelf in the inventory.
typed: A spare that isn't in the inventory
step2Desc: Paste the dead switch's last config copy into the spare before you patch it in.
noCopy: There is no config copy of this switch yet.
configHidden: Your role can't read switch configs. Ask someone who can.
step3: 3. Patch it back the same way
step3Desc_one: {{count}} seat is on this switch: each cable goes back into the same port.
step3Desc_other: {{count}} seats are on this switch: each cable goes back into the same port.
noSeats: No seat is mapped to this switch.
step4Desc: The switch takes the spare's serial number and model. The spare's inventory entry takes the dead box's, as failed, for the return. The swap goes into the audit log and onto the open incident.
